scenario: Operator overwrites a wrong value without preserving the predecessor
required_evidence: Two immutable assertion IDs and correction link
rollback_or_compensation: Restore from protected history if possible
evidence_boundary: No claim that a stored current value proves correction completeness

scenario: A manager proposes a correction outside the manager's recorded scope
required_evidence: Current authority record and exact scope
readback_method: Read exact approval and scope record
rollback_or_compensation: Retain predecessor as governing until approved
evidence_boundary: No legal employment or role conclusion

scenario: Corrected value is known but its governing start time is unknown
required_evidence: Dated source evidence and time-basis rule
rollback_or_compensation: Do not backdate or recompute history
evidence_boundary: No historical fact or customer-impact conclusion

scenario: Correction arrives in an unreferenced chat message
required_evidence: Qualified source reference and author identity
readback_method: Open evidence reference and compare subject
rollback_or_compensation: Preserve reported candidate separately
evidence_boundary: No claim that message delivery establishes truth

scenario: Source row changed and ticket is marked complete
required_evidence: Named consumer inventory with dispositions
rollback_or_compensation: Reopen correction and freeze dependency snapshot
evidence_boundary: Source update is not operational closure

scenario: Historical recommendation contains the superseded assertion
required_evidence: Original input envelope and correction ID
readback_method: Read immutable record plus correction link
rollback_or_compensation: Remove current-use eligibility without altering history
evidence_boundary: No recommendation quality or model-performance claim

scenario: Customer-facing fictional message was already sent
required_evidence: Exact sent record recipient scope and consequence review
rollback_or_compensation: Issue correction notice only if authorized
evidence_boundary: No actual recipient delivery harm or resolution evidence

scenario: Visible page changes but structured data retains predecessor
required_evidence: Page and structured-data versions
rollback_or_compensation: Restore prior release or correct both
evidence_boundary: No publication indexing or search-display claim

scenario: Write receipt is labeled reconciled
required_evidence: Separated accepted executed readback and reconciled states
readback_method: Compare state ledger and output query
rollback_or_compensation: Correct status without altering receipt
evidence_boundary: Provider receipt is not governing-output proof

scenario: Spreadsheet consumer is assigned no action without a reason
required_evidence: Reason owner consequence class and review date
rollback_or_compensation: Quarantine spreadsheet from current use
evidence_boundary: No claim that low effort means low consequence

scenario: Source changes again after correction qualification
required_evidence: Current predecessor hash or entity tag
rollback_or_compensation: Create superseding packet from new predecessor
evidence_boundary: No lost-update prevention beyond tested resource

scenario: HTTP cache invalidated but nightly export remains old
required_evidence: Cache receipt export manifest and source version
readback_method: Fresh GET plus export row check
rollback_or_compensation: Rebuild export or hold distribution
evidence_boundary: Cache invalidation does not prove derivative correction

scenario: Report recomputed with an unrecorded new formula
required_evidence: Input versions transformation ID and code hash
rollback_or_compensation: Recompute with approved version
evidence_boundary: No metric truth financial or performance claim

scenario: Retry creates two correction notices
required_evidence: Stable idempotency key and prior execution receipt
rollback_or_compensation: Suppress duplicate and preserve both attempts
evidence_boundary: No real send delivery or response claim

scenario: Delete marker may expire before slow consumer catches up
required_evidence: Retention deadline and consumer checkpoint
stop_condition: Consumer cannot observe marker before deadline
rollback_or_compensation: Use qualified snapshot rebuild path
evidence_boundary: No Kafka deployment or delivery guarantee

scenario: Consumer reports healthy but checkpoint predates correction
required_evidence: Partition offset or equivalent version checkpoint
readback_method: Query consumer position and governing state
rollback_or_compensation: Replay from bounded qualified source
evidence_boundary: Health status is not correction observation

scenario: Same correction packet runs after completion
required_evidence: Execution receipt idempotency key and output version
stop_condition: Output or side effect would duplicate
rollback_or_compensation: Return existing receipt without executing
evidence_boundary: No general exactly-once guarantee

scenario: Predecessor event arrives after corrected state is serving
required_evidence: Event time observation time version and causation chain
stop_condition: Late event would regress governing state
readback_method: Read state version after attempted ingest
rollback_or_compensation: Reject or route to adjudication
evidence_boundary: No assertion about real provider ordering

scenario: Second authorized correction arrives before first reconciles
required_evidence: Two packets authority and precedence rule
rollback_or_compensation: Close first as superseded not reconciled
evidence_boundary: No automatic merge or truth selection claim

scenario: Four consumers pass and one fails
required_evidence: Per-consumer receipts and states
rollback_or_compensation: Roll back affected high-consequence consumers or isolate
evidence_boundary: Partial success is not correction closure

scenario: Graph query excludes manually maintained workbook
required_evidence: Closure query known-gap register and owner
readback_method: Compare inventory to access and export evidence
rollback_or_compensation: Hold workbook distribution and add consumer
evidence_boundary: No claim that graph traversal proves complete reality

scenario: Report and feature store derive from each other
required_evidence: Versioned dependency graph and cycle trace
rollback_or_compensation: Break cycle under approved source rule
evidence_boundary: No claim that topology alone establishes semantic correctness

scenario: Old chunk deleted but response cache serves prior answer
required_evidence: Chunk manifest index version response-cache version and query probe
rollback_or_compensation: Invalidate response cache and rebuild
evidence_boundary: Retrieval readback is not model truth or safety evidence

scenario: Corrected identity changes benchmark cohort membership
required_evidence: Old and new dataset manifests labels and inclusion rule
stop_condition: Published score would be silently edited
readback_method: Compare cohort rows and recomputed outputs
rollback_or_compensation: Publish versioned correction note if released
evidence_boundary: No benchmark causal model or industry-performance claim

scenario: Historical recommendation is rewritten with corrected context
required_evidence: Immutable original envelope correction link and reevaluation ID
rollback_or_compensation: Restore original and create separate reevaluation
evidence_boundary: No claim the reevaluated recommendation would be better

scenario: Owned page updates while downloadable fact sheet stays old
required_evidence: Canonical manifest file hashes and dependency list
rollback_or_compensation: Restore prior release or update atomically
evidence_boundary: No crawl indexing ranking or coverage claim

scenario: Fictional ledger reversal affects unreleased management draft
required_evidence: Ledger snapshot transformation version and accounting owner
stop_condition: Accounting authority or posting state unresolved
readback_method: Compare corrected draft to governing ledger
rollback_or_compensation: Retain restricted predecessor draft for audit
evidence_boundary: No revenue cash accounting valuation or financial-statement evidence

scenario: Wrong fictional eligibility fact already triggered an access change
required_evidence: Action receipt current access state authority and safety review
stop_condition: Physical or access consequence lacks qualified owner
rollback_or_compensation: Use authorized compensating action not blind replay
evidence_boundary: No real access instruction safety conclusion or incident closure

scenario: Device reading was attached to wrong fictional unit
required_evidence: Mapping versions affected-event set and incident owner
readback_method: Query corrected mapping and affected records
rollback_or_compensation: Preserve original attribution plus correction link
evidence_boundary: No real sensor condition alarm or safety event

scenario: Correction packet copies private customer value into broad register
required_evidence: Data classification protected reference and least-necessary review
stop_condition: Sensitive raw value leaves approved boundary
readback_method: Inspect register fields and access scope
rollback_or_compensation: Replace value with protected reference or hash
evidence_boundary: No privacy compliance or legal conclusion

scenario: Fictional packet passes JSON Schema and is called operationally correct
required_evidence: Schema report plus truth authority dependency and readback reviews
stop_condition: Structural conformance is used as fitness proof
rollback_or_compensation: Correct claim and keep packet held
evidence_boundary: Schema validity is not truth authority safety or closure

scenario: Consumer graph changes during propagation
required_evidence: Dependency snapshot diff and new consumer owner
stop_condition: Execution targets no longer match approved closure
rollback_or_compensation: Create revised approved propagation plan
evidence_boundary: No claim a stale graph remains complete

scenario: Column lineage exists but row cohort affected by correction is unknown
required_evidence: Row-selection rule cohort query and uncertainty bound
rollback_or_compensation: Quarantine derivative or recompute broader safe scope
evidence_boundary: No exact impact count without reproducible cohort

scenario: Event replay can resend a message or reopen access
required_evidence: Side-effect inventory suppression controls and consequence approval
readback_method: Run dry simulation and inspect provider state
rollback_or_compensation: Use state repair or compensating action instead
evidence_boundary: Technical idempotency is not business-effect safety

scenario: Source assertion retracted but derived recommendation stays eligible
required_evidence: Retraction event dependency edge and recommendation status
stop_condition: Derivative remains eligible for current use
rollback_or_compensation: Remove eligibility and create separate reevaluation
evidence_boundary: No inference that retraction reverses prior human action

scenario: Vendor accepts correction request with tracking ID
required_evidence: Exact request receipt provider state and public or API readback
stop_condition: Provider output not independently read back
readback_method: Check exact target surface or API
rollback_or_compensation: Follow governed escalation window
evidence_boundary: Request receipt is not delivery acceptance publication or correction

scenario: Primary region is corrected but secondary region is stale
required_evidence: Region-specific version and readback evidence
rollback_or_compensation: Hold release or invalidate lagging replica
evidence_boundary: One-region success is not global consistency proof

scenario: Two authorized packets target same assertion concurrently
required_evidence: Precondition precedence policy and authority comparison
readback_method: Read current version and active packet registry
rollback_or_compensation: Choose explicit supersession order
evidence_boundary: No automated truth selection from timestamp alone

scenario: Old snapshot remains queryable after current correction
required_evidence: Snapshot IDs current pointer retention policy and consumer rule
stop_condition: Historical snapshot can be mistaken for current
rollback_or_compensation: Label or restrict current-decision use
evidence_boundary: Historical availability does not make old data current

scenario: Nonreversible effect remains after all mutable consumers pass
required_evidence: Named residual authority evidence and review date
readback_method: Read residual ledger and owner approval
rollback_or_compensation: Execute approved compensation if later available
evidence_boundary: Accepted residual is not reversal resolution safety or absence of harm
